purpose: Method-level comparison of contrastive self-supervised pretraining against an otherwise matched supervised MLP. This is not another feature ablation or a claim that SCARF will beat the current model.

sources.title: SCARF: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning using Random Feature Corruption
sources.use: Algorithm 1, preprocessing and architecture/training section. Implement the published algorithm independently in existing PyTorch; do not describe it as an author-provided PyTorch implementation.

sources.title: VIME author implementation, alternative considered
sources.use: The reference uses legacy Keras/TensorFlow and a frozen pretrained encoder. Its mixed-type reconstruction and consistency adaptation would add more implementation choices than the selected SCARF experiment.

comparison.candidate: SCARF pretrained encoder plus supervised fine-tuning of encoder and classification head
comparison.matched_control: Identical encoder and classification head, preprocessing, supervised optimizer and stopping protocol, trained from scratch without contrastive pretraining
comparison.business_reference: v44_seed_ensemble on the same fixed development folds
comparison.interpretation: Historical MLP/TabM recipes are not matched controls. v44 includes different engineered features and spatial priors, so it is a practical performance reference rather than a pure architecture control.

data_and_validation.outer_split: Exactly the existing fixed development StratifiedKFold; reuse its indices, never redraw to improve a score.
data_and_validation.supervised_inner_split: Stratified 80/20 of outer-training rows, random_state equal to that outer model seed. Reuse the same split for scratch and SCARF and record index hashes.
data_and_validation.early_stopping_labels: Only the inner validation labels; outer validation labels are used only for the completed outer prediction metrics.
data_and_validation.unlabeled_pool: Current supervised training rows with Transported removed, plus the actual 4277 test rows. Exclude the corresponding inner/outer validation rows and the old holdout from pretraining.
data_and_validation.unlabeled_validation: A fixed seeded 10 percent partition of the actual test attributes, with no labels, monitors contrastive pretraining. Donor values come only from the remaining pretraining pool. This partition never determines a classification threshold or feature choice.
data_and_validation.pool_size_note: Outer refit uses approximately 4636 training attributes plus 4277 test attributes, or 8913 rows. Final full-label fitting uses 8693 plus 4277, or 12970. Full-roster transductive pretraining including validation attributes is deliberately not part of this proposal.
prohibited: reusing a global development-fitted encoder across outer folds

input.numeric_processing: Record original missing flags; log1p the five spending columns; median imputation and StandardScaler fitted only on the current supervised training partition. An all-missing numeric column has fixed fallback zero and its missing flag remains present.
input.categorical_processing: Training-only vocabulary with explicit unknown and missing categories, followed by one-hot encoding. Unknown values do not silently become an observed category.
input.fairness_note: The original 13 semantic fields and seven numeric missing flags match the NN input scope; SCARF uses paper-style one-hot categorical inputs rather than transformer tokens. Both SCARF and its scratch control use exactly the same encoded input.

corruption.selection: Uniformly choose exactly floor(0.6 * 13) original feature groups without replacement per row; regenerate on each training pass.
corruption.donors: For each selected group independently sample a donor row uniformly from the pretraining training pool. Copy that group's value from the donor; never use Transported or teacher predictions.
corruption.categorical_integrity: Replace a categorical value before one-hot encoding, equivalently copy its entire one-hot group. Never corrupt individual one-hot bits.
corruption.missing_integrity: Copy a numeric value and its original missing flag together as one semantic group. Other fields remain unchanged.
corruption.validation_views: Precompute and freeze ten deterministic corruption passes and batch memberships over the unlabeled validation partition; use the same validation pairs every epoch.
known_risks: Independent marginal replacement can break CryoSleep/spending relationships.
Similar passengers can become contrastive negatives.
A corruption recipe that works on other tables is not guaranteed to preserve information useful for this target.

network.encoder: Four Linear-to-256 plus ReLU layers, no dropout or BatchNorm in this initial recipe.
network.projection_head: Linear 256-to-256, ReLU, Linear 256-to-256, then L2 normalization.
network.classification_head: Linear 256-to-256, ReLU, Linear 256-to-1; use a binary logit.
network.head_convention: The two-layer head means two affine layers including its output layer. This explicit binary-output convention must be documented as part of the local implementation.
network.pretraining_loss: Temperature-one directional N-by-N cross-view InfoNCE: clean anchors against corrupted views, diagonal positive pairs, off-diagonal negatives. Cross entropy on similarity logits; the additive log(N) convention does not alter gradients.
network.fine_tuning_loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss on clean labeled inputs; discard the projection head and update the full encoder and classification head.
network.initialization: Record separate deterministic encoder, projection, classification-head and corruption RNG seeds. Scratch and SCARF use matched initial encoder/head seeds; the intended difference is pretraining.

training.device: Existing local PyTorch, float32 MPS after a resource/gradient probe. No cloud inference, pretrained checkpoint downloads or new dependency installation are required by this design.
refit_sequence: Fit preprocessing on inner supervised training rows only.
For SCARF, select a pretraining epoch on fixed unlabeled validation InfoNCE and restore that encoder checkpoint. No target label is used in pretraining.
Select supervised epochs separately for SCARF and scratch using the same inner validation rows and logloss rule. Fine-tune the entire encoder for SCARF.

Freshly fit preprocessing on all outer-training rows and reinitialize the appropriate network. For SCARF pretrain on all outer-training attributes plus all actual test attributes for the selected pretraining epoch count, without early stopping on outer validation.
Train on all outer-training labels for that candidate's selected supervised epoch count, then predict the outer validation once. Scratch follows the same fresh-refit protocol without pretraining.
training.paper_vs_local_protocol: Width, encoder depth, corruption rate, temperature, optimizer learning rate and batch size follow the paper recipe. The paper's pretraining patience is3, supervised patience is3 with classification-error stopping and cap200, and ten refers to static validation corruption passes. Our pretraining patience10, supervised patience40/cap500/logloss, and explicit missing categories/flags are local adaptations, not an exact reproduction of the paper benchmark.
training.resource_budget: Set and freeze stage wall-clock budgets only after an exclusive-device, non-scoring resource probe. Do not use artificially short budgets to declare a family ineffective. If interrupted or still improving at the cap, mark training adequacy inconclusive rather than silently reporting a completed weak baseline.

required_evidence: No labels reach the pretraining pool or corruption routine; outer validation rows do not reach fitted preprocessing or pretraining.
One real finite backward step changes encoder parameters; a missing/category group is copied intact during corruption.
Pretraining and fine-tuning train/validation curves, selected epoch, last epoch, effective optimizer steps and cap-hit flag for every fold.
Parameter count, train/predict time, process lifetime RSS and MPS snapshots; snapshots must not be described as continuous peak GPU memory.
Complete fixed-fold OOF accuracy, logloss, per-fold results and paired differences against matched scratch and v44; threshold remains 0.5.
Serialized CPU weights, fitted preprocessing, category vocabularies and schema reproduce predictions; export follows the same declared training recipe.

continuation_rule.worth_follow_up: A trained-to-adequacy recipe with consistent gains over matched scratch and competitive performance against v44 merits a predeclared small tuning study or three-initialization stability check.
continuation_rule.not_a_family_rejection: One converged recipe losing means this recipe did not help on these data; it does not establish that every SCARF/MLP configuration fails.
continuation_rule.inconclusive: Budget exhaustion, unresolved nonfinite gradients, unverified reconstruction, or a best epoch at a still-improving cap require implementation/budget diagnosis rather than score-based family rejection.
continuation_rule.online_gate_unchanged: The existing greater-than-83-percent local gate and explicit user approval for a future Kaggle submission remain unchanged.
